stem:
Omkar makes a tiny pencil mark on his notebook page and labels it P.

In geometry, what does this mark stand for?

options.text: A point: a precise location with no length, breadth, or thickness, named by the letter P.
A short line segment that starts at P and has a measurable length.
The black disk of graphite itself, which has a real size on the page.
Any decorative blot on the page, even when it does not name a location.

teacher.key_rationale: A point is an invisibly thin location named by a capital letter; the pencil mark is only a visible model of that location.
